name: LangChain Certified Agent Engineer

fee.note: Published USD exam price; each purchase includes one free resit. Platform usage is separate.

exam.format: 40 multiple-choice questions, 120 minutes (about 135 minutes of seat time), live proctored online through Talview, in English; 24-month validity. Semi-open-book: only LangChain-owned resources (LangSmith, LangChain docs and LangChain Academy) may be used, and a dedicated LangSmith organization is provided for some questions.

access.retake: Each exam purchase includes one free resit (request the code through Talview support); further resits are unlimited at the full fee, with any discount or partner codes applied, and last-minute cancellations or late joins do not earn an extra free resit.
access.accommodations: Request accommodations through a Talview support ticket before scheduling the exam.

scope: Building, evaluating and operating agents with the LangChain and LangSmith stack. The issuer offers free courses and a practice assessment.
ai_policy: AI assistants, the AI helper on docs.langchain.com, browser automation and general web search are not allowed; only LangSmith, LangChain docs and LangChain Academy may be consulted.
caveats: The exam page lists six free prerequisite courses, while LangChain's support article (October 16, 2026) says five.

prep.title: LCAE exam guide (PDF)
prep.note: Exam rules, allowed resources, focus areas and recommended courses for each section, and the resit policy.

prep.title: LCAE prerequisite courses
prep.note: The six free LangChain Academy courses the exam page lists as prerequisites; LangChain says exam questions draw on them.

prep.title: LCAE Practice Exam
prep.note: Official practice exam covering the four sections.

prep.title: LangChain Academy
prep.note: Free courses; the issuer also offers a practice assessment.

domains_note: Weights from the LangChain Academy LCAE exam page ('Domains covered'), read 2026-11-17; the exam guide PDF linked there gives the same split (10 questions, 25% of score per section).
